plans.name: Mutate the approved order before capture
plans.idea: The capture handler may use the session's latest shop order, or a second create call may upsert the same ref/PayPal order, without rechecking that the captured amount still matches the fulfilled lines.

plans.name: Duplicate-line price/fulfilment split
plans.idea: Pricing may collapse duplicate SKUs through a map or object while fulfilment iterates the raw lines, or the reverse validation may assume the storefront cart can never contain duplicates.

plans.name: Transplant a completed capture at capture time
plans.idea: The capture endpoint may trust capture identifiers or completion fields supplied in its request body, or verify the supplied old PayPal order while marking the order named in the path as paid, without checking custom_id linkage.

plans.name: Retarget a real capture webhook
plans.idea: The webhook handler may look up the shop order solely from edited custom_id/invoice fields and may not confirm that the capture belongs to that order or that this capture was not already consumed by another order.

plans.name: Capture another shopper's approved order
plans.idea: PayPal order 77Y56638MF767953X for shop order KC-C05F7E was approved but had no capture in the events; the capture route may not bind a PayPal order to the session that created or approved it.

plans.name: Currency denomination swap
plans.idea: Extra currency or purchase-unit fields may be passed through to PayPal, or capture validation may compare only the numeric value and ignore the currency code.
